method: Parsed 15 named application/case-study headings, corresponding LaTeX figure environments, figure captions and archived assets. Results-figure classification is caption-grounded and conservative; no experiment inferred from a pipeline schematic.
original_three_confirmed_real_data_repla: Figure 11.11 (real heated-rod thermocouples; outside named application heading)
warnings: The Sepsis Prediction section and its nested Translational Sepsis case study both reference Figure 11.19; they remain separately named units but are not independent executed results.
Presence of architecture and workflow diagrams never fulfills the requirement for actual experiment output figures.
Real photographs are authentic data; genuine model outputs are valid when labeled as such.
The final revised LaTeX and binary assets reside in the local ZIP and have not been verified committed to the GitHub canonical release.
Other chapters have not been audited to this same manuscript-to-figure depth.
